reserveReview.reviewer: Codex Apyx Accountable live reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: Refresh 2026-08-28: the headered Accountable dashboard API snapshot at 2026-08-27T22:00:04.418Z (payload ts 1787868004418) reports reserves_split USD values STRC 185788309.66, Inventory 48129916.91, Protocol Owned Liquidity 47941097.57, Cash & Equivalents 28831033.88, and Other 6320.88 against total_reserves 310696678.89. The current live accountable adapter normalizes those positive values to 59.8% STRC, 15.5% Inventory, 15.4% Protocol Owned Liquidity, and 9.3% Cash & Equivalents; Other is 0.002% and rounds out below the adapter's one-decimal output. The payload reports collateralization 0.993626 on the net-of-protocol-owned denominator (gross reserves/supply is 99.56% against total_supply 312073514.82), so the normalized composition remains a mix of disclosed reserves only and is not 100% liability coverage. STRC remains Strategy, Inc. perpetual preferred equity; Protocol Owned Liquidity and Inventory remain undisclosed Apyx-protocol baskets, while Cash & Equivalents still combines USDC and U.S. Treasury bills without a split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Timestamped Accountable reserves_split snapshot normalized by the current accountable live-reserve adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: USDC cannot be isolated from Treasury backing in Cash & Equivalents, while the source-native Protocol Owned Liquidity and Inventory buckets do not disclose their constituent assets. The source's opaque Other bucket is 0.002% and is below the live adapter's one-decimal emitted-slice threshold.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Apyx states it works with custodians monthly to obtain attestations that backing assets exist and remain under custody control (Wolf & Company opinions published for March-June 2026 on the third-party attestation index), but the custodian identities, account segregation terms, bankruptcy-remoteness structure, and rehypothecation permissions are not disclosed in the reviewed documentation. The refreshed 2026-08-27 reserves_split places the protocol-controlled Inventory (15.5%) and Protocol Owned Liquidity (15.4%) buckets at 30.9% combined, with no stated custody arrangement.
